answer_reference_text: Mask R-CNN was authored by Kaiming He, Georgia Gkioxari, Piotr Dollár, and Ross Girshick. Other detection papers in the corpus sharing at least one author include Faster R-CNN (Girshick, He, Dollár et al.), Feature Pyramid Networks (Lin, Dollár, Girshick, He et al.), and RetinaNet/Focal Loss (Lin, Goyal, Girshick, He, Dollár).
